column1: # sequences.tsv: ops in one scenario run on one fake NVS; 'reboot' = a fresh boot (RAM state back to build defaults, init again on the same NVS; shown as an init row tagged reboot). Columns: scenario, step, op, ... same columns as setters.tsv for set rows; init rows as defaults.tsv (op, tag, init_result, getters, nvs_after). write_error_*: every NVS value write (set_) or commit fails with a generic error: the in-memory value, listener and return code are unaffected by the failure.
